About

The person behind the code.

I'm Jefferson David, a BSIT student based in Philippines. with an interest in web development, game development, software development, and programming. I'm passionate about exploring how technology works and using what I learn to build useful and meaningful projects.

Throughout my journey as an IT student, I've gained experience working with different programming languages and technologies, including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, MySQL, Java, C#, and Python.

I enjoy learning through hands-on experience, experimenting with new ideas, and challenging myself to solve problems through programming. I'm still growing as a developer, and I'm always looking for opportunities to improve my skills and expand my knowledge.

My goal is to continue developing my technical abilities and create projects that combine functionality, creativity, and practical solutions.
